ru.name: Комбо: Золотой терновник V

en.name: Flow: Golden Thorns V
en.description: Transmute gold along the trajectory of your sledgehammer that pierces your foes. Any contact with your sledgehammer also creates alchemic circles which draw up golden thorns beneath your enemy's feet.
tooltip: 34.14% damage in PvP only
